items.text: Microsoft reportedly tightened employee AI budgets after one worker consumed $28,000 in tokens within 28 days.
items.text_zh: 据报道，一名员工在28天内消耗了价值2.8万美元的令牌后，微软收紧了员工的AI预算。

items.text: A TTFT-focused benchmark compared inference APIs to identify the lowest-latency options for voice and real-time AI agents.
items.text_zh: 一项聚焦首令牌时间的基准测试比较了多种推理接口，以寻找适合语音和实时AI智能体的最低延迟方案。

items.text: Together AI reported GLM-5.3 had a substantially lower hallucination rate than Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Luna in its evaluation.
items.text_zh: Together AI表示，在其评测中，GLM-5.3的幻觉率显著低于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Luna。

items.text: Google introduced EnvHarness, a programmable layer that converts static agent environments into adaptive worlds for training and evaluation.
items.text_zh: 谷歌推出EnvHarness，通过可编程中间层把静态智能体环境转变为可用于训练和评测的自适应世界。

items.text: GitHub said automated Dependabot pull requests comprised roughly one-sixth of commits on Microsoft’s GCToolkit, illustrating alert-fatigue risks.
items.text_zh: GitHub称，微软GCToolkit约六分之一的提交来自Dependabot自动拉取请求，凸显更新提醒过载的风险。

items.text: xAI’s faster route to installing gas turbines for AI infrastructure could increase local air pollution, according to TechCrunch.
items.text_zh: 据TechCrunch报道，xAI为AI基础设施加速部署燃气轮机的做法可能加重当地空气污染。

items.text: Databricks outlined a new batch of platform features and explained how they fit into its broader data and AI architecture.
items.text_zh: Databricks介绍了一批平台新功能，并说明它们如何融入其整体数据与AI架构。

items.text: Texas Governor Greg Abbott blocked state funding for additional Flock automated license-plate cameras amid surveillance concerns.
items.text_zh: 由于外界担忧监控风险，得克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特阻止州政府继续资助新增Flock自动车牌识别摄像头。

items.text: Caterpillar is applying operational lessons from autonomous mining equipment to industrial AI deployment and management.
items.text_zh: 卡特彼勒正把自动化采矿设备积累的运营经验应用于工业AI的部署和管理。

items.text: An industry analysis argued that young AI startups commonly postpone infrastructure optimization until scale makes inefficiency financially painful.
items.text_zh: 一篇行业分析指出，年轻AI初创公司通常会推迟基础设施优化，直到规模扩大使低效率带来明显成本压力。

items.text: SiliconANGLE detailed four safeguards intended to reduce harmful or unauthorized behavior by autonomous AI agents.
items.text_zh: SiliconANGLE介绍了四项防护措施，旨在减少自主AI智能体造成有害行为或执行未授权操作的风险。

items.text: Employee-review analysis found workplace sentiment toward corporate AI adoption becoming increasingly negative amid pressure, disruption and uncertain benefits.
items.text_zh: 一项员工评价分析发现，在工作压力、岗位扰动和收益不明朗的影响下，员工对企业采用AI的态度日益消极。

items.text: Meta is developing robots to inspect, maintain and operate data centers as AI infrastructure expands.
items.text_zh: 随着AI基础设施不断扩张，Meta正在开发可检查、维护和操作数据中心设施的机器人。
